message.content: {"skills": [{"slot": 1, "name": "Feed 导出配置与回退解析", "description": "根据每个 feed 定义解析导出配置键，并在缺失时回退到对应的全局设置（如 FEED_EXPORT_ENCODING、FEED_EXPORT_FIELDS、FEED_STORE_EMPTY、FEED_URI_PARAMS）。用于需要确定最终生效的 feed 参数时。", "asset_type": "knowledge_reference", "asset_node_id": "knowledge_reference_node", "granularity": "micro", "objective": "确定每个 feed 定义最终生效的导出参数及其回退来源", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "feed_export_configuration", "method_family": "config_resolution", "stage": "configuration", "use_when": ["需要确认某个 feed 键的最终取值", "某个 feed 键未显式提供，需要知道回退设置"], "do_not_use_when": ["需要实现自定义 exporter 或 storage 类", "需要处理 item 过滤或后处理插件逻辑"], "success_artifact": "一份解析后的 feed 参数表，标明每个键的取值及回退来源", "why_distinct": "这是配置解析的参考知识，不涉及导出执行流程或存储后端行为", "evidence_span_hint": "The following is a list of the accepted keys and the setting that is used as a fallback value", "confidence": 0.85}, {"slot": 2, "name": "Feed 覆盖与追加策略选择", "description": "根据存储后端（本地文件系统、FTP、S3、GCS、标准输出）决定 overwrite 的默认行为，并处理不支持追加的后端。用于配置 feed 写入模式时。", "asset_type": "knowledge_reference", "asset_node_id": "knowledge_reference_node", "granularity": "micro", "objective": "为给定存储后端选择正确的 overwrite/append 行为", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "feed_export_configuration", "method_family": "storage_backend_policy", "stage": "configuration", "use_when": ["需要决定 feed 文件是否覆盖或追加", "目标存储后端可能不支持追加操作"], "do_not_use_when": ["仅需选择序列化格式", "需要配置 item 过滤或后处理插件"], "success_artifact": "针对所选存储后端的 overwrite 取值及追加可行性说明", "why_distinct": "聚焦存储后端的写入模式策略，与参数回退解析是不同决策点", "evidence_span_hint": "overwrite: whether to overwrite the file if it already exists", "confidence": 0.8}]}
